Recorded answers for the source tests. Torrentio, EZTV, The Pirate Bay, Knaben and Nyaa files
were recorded from one live call each (2026-10-26). `yts/list_movies.json` was recorded from the live API (Blade Runner, 2026-10-26; the old yts.mx domain no longer exists, the API answers on movies-api.accel.li), `*/empty.*`,
`*/error.*`, `*/malformed.*` and the HTML pages are hand-made edge cases.

`latest/` holds hand-made answers in the shape the live sites gave for their newest-releases listings on 2026-10-31 (YTS `list_movies` by `date_added`, EZTV `get-torrents` without an IMDb ID, The Pirate Bay `q.php?q=category:<id>`, Knaben's v1 POST, Nyaa's RSS, a Torznab feed and its "query required" error), with invented titles and hashes.
